app_id.description: The public app ID (e.g. 5X3c4veRGV) from list_apps

current_app_version.description: Filter devices currently running this app version.

date_range_end.description: ISO 8601 datetime. Filter devices active up to this date.

date_range_start.description: ISO 8601 datetime. Filter devices active from this date.

enabled.description: Filter by enabled (true) or disabled (false) devices.

log_level.description: Filter devices that have logs at this level. 0=Debug, 1=Warning, 2=Error, 3=Trace, 4=Info, 5=Fatal

log_text.description: Filter devices that have logs matching this text.

name.description: Filter by device name. Use * as suffix wildcard (e.g. iPhone*)

next_cursor.description: Cursor for next page, from pagination.next_cursor in previous response.

os_name.description: Filter by operating system name (e.g. iOS, Android).
